variations.title: Hydraulic & Civil
variations.desc:
Hydraulic Engineer:
Stormwater & Sump Pump Design: Certifying the channel grate drain, pump station capacity, dual-pump redundancy, and backup power to protect the basement against inundation.

Civil Engineer:
Overland Surface Flow / Crest Height: Demonstrating that surface runoff from the street or surrounding property cannot surcharge into the basement entrance.
